skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The suit Phantom wore when he returned from Wrankwood.
The resplendent ornaments and staff belie a cruel secret. Speak not of it to anyone. Instead, use it to write a fine script.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Layer after layer of curtains are torn away, but there is no trace of the actor.
When the stage lights turn on, he hides away in a shadow in the depths of the story. The one who stands on the stage right now, is you.
